summary: Frontend-only testing of Iter58 features: (1) variable search input added to BOTH email template editors and (2) cursor-aware variable insertion (Subject vs Body). Both editors tested end-to-end against the public preview URL. All acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Hydration warnings in console: '<span> cannot contain <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>'. Not blocking and not related to Iter58, but should be cleaned up by main agent in a follow-up.

critical_code_review_comments: EmailTemplatesEditor.jsx: insertVariable() relies on document.getElementById('template-subject'/'template-body') and on selectionStart of the underlying DOM nodes. With shadcn Input/Textarea this works because they forward refs, but it would be safer to use refs. Acceptable in current scope.

TemplatesAdminDialog.jsx: onFocusCapture sets activeField='body' for the whole wrapper div around the RichTextEditor; the indicator switches correctly. insertVar() uses editorRef.insertText() for TipTap which respects cursor position. Verified working.

Both panels share VARIABLE_CATEGORIES from /components/email/templateVariables.js, so parity (67 vars / 6 groups) is structurally guaranteed. Confirmed at runtime: 67 unique chips in BOTH editors when search is empty.
Existing console hydration error (<tr> inside <span>, <span> as <tbody> child) is unrelated to Iter58 but should be addressed.
